name: okbook-ai
description: Discover restaurants in Japan, check availability, and open the corresponding OKBook restaurant page.

interface.longDescription: Discover restaurants across Japan, explore restaurant details, ratings and reviews, check availability for a requested date, time and party size, and open the corresponding OKBook restaurant page. The plugin is read-only: it does not create, modify or cancel reservations and does not collect payments inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Show restaurants in Osaka with availability for two people tomorrow evening.
Tell me about a restaurant and open its OKBook page.

prompts: Find a restaurant in Shibuya for two people tomorrow at 19:00 and check availability.
Show me the details and diner reviews for one of the restaurants you found.
Open the restaurant's OKBook page so I can continue there.

positive.description: Search by area and cuisine and return a nonempty list of matching restaurants.
positive.expected_behavior: Call dining_concierge with Ginza as the region and sushi as the genre. Return only restaurants supported by the tool response and present the restaurant list without claiming a reservation was made.

positive.description: Look up a specific restaurant by its full name and show the restaurant detail panel.
positive.prompt: Find Sushi Maru in Shinjuku and show me its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Call dining_concierge with the full restaurant name in shopName and Shinjuku as the region. If a match is returned, show details grounded in the response; if no exact match is returned, explain that and do not fabricate restaurant facts.

positive.description: Check availability for a specific date, time and party size using Japan time.
positive.prompt: Find a restaurant in Shibuya with availability tomorrow around 19:00 for two people.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve tomorrow from the conversation date, search in Shibuya, and pass the resolved date, 19:00 and a party size of two when checking a specific restaurant. Clearly distinguish confirmed availability, request-only availability and no availability.

positive.description: Explain a restaurant rating using the structured rating breakdown.
positive.prompt: For one of the sushi restaurants you found, explain its rating strengths and weaknesses.
positive.expected_behavior: Use dining_concierge to identify a restaurant and get_restaurant_ratings with the returned slug. Base the explanation only on the returned rating dimensions and distribution.

positive.description: Summarize real diner feedback for a restaurant and provide its external OKBook page.
positive.prompt: Show me recent diner feedback for one of the restaurants you found and give me its OKBook page.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the restaurant slug returned by dining_concierge, summarize only themes present in get_restaurant_reviews, and provide only the external OKBook link returned by the tools.

negative.description: The plugin must not create a reservation inside ChatGPT. It may explain the limitation and offer the external OKBook restaurant page, but must not claim success.
negative.prompt: Book a table for two tonight and confirm the reservation here without sending me to another website.

negative.description: The plugin cannot modify or cancel an existing reservation and must not claim that it has done so.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing restaurant reservation and confirm the refund.

negative.description: The plugin cannot collect payment or charge a card inside ChatGPT and must direct the user to an appropriate external flow instead.
negative.prompt: Charge my card now and pay the restaurant deposit inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Provides read-only restaurant discovery, restaurant details, ratings, reviews, availability checks and external OKBook restaurant links. Does not create reservations or collect payments inside ChatGPT.
